params.prompt: Cinematic miniature diorama, heroic armored-tech workshop aesthetic: glossy hot-rod red and gold metal plating with crisp panel lines and rivets, brushed gunmetal accents, warm tungsten garage lighting, subtle cool reactor-glow highlights, tilt-shift miniature photography look, isometric three-quarter aerial view, ultra detailed, empty, unoccupied, no people, architectural model quality. On a plain solid deep warm charcoal background with a soft contact shadow. Palette: hot-rod red #B91C1C, gold #D4A017, gunmetal #3F3F46, amber core glow, warm white #FAF7F0. No text, no letters, no logos, centered composition. IMPORTANT: any armor design must be an entirely original invented design, NOT resembling Iron Man or any Marvel or famous superhero. Subject: a skyscraper rooftop landing platform at golden hour — standing centered on the helipad is an original armored suit of unique invented design: full-face smooth featureless visor with a single glowing horizontal eye-slit and no mouth plate, angular swept-back helmet crest fin, hot-rod red torso plating, brushed gunmetal arms and legs, thin gold trim edges, a hexagonal amber power core embedded in the chest, landing lights, the miniature city skyline wrapping around the tower base.
